svg.title: Draw budget versus edge retention, verdict disagreement and conclusive certification
svg.desc: Three descriptive panels compare effective-resistance sampling, blue circles and solid lines, with uniform sampling, vermilion squares and dashed lines, at20,40,70,110,170,350 and700 draws with replacement. At110 draws effective resistance retains68.05percent of distinct edges, disagrees in63of180 evaluations and has0of180 conclusive certificates. Each method/budget contains180 graph-scale evaluations from18 sampling instances reused across10 scales. Comparisons match draws, not distinct edges or runtime. No confidence interval or superiority claim is implied.
